decisions.reason: The reference-class electrometer is a core measurement instrument featured on the home page, which signals strong public commitment and fit with the firm's dosimetry direction, and a single year is too short to judge sales of a niche instrument.

The oncology risk management software has its own page and represents a deliberate software extension of the firm's announced direction, so sunk development costs and the long sales cycles in clinical markets make management likely to read slow uptake as temporary and persist.
